Name: Abrah's Summer Pack
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
[center][b]ABRAH'S SUMMER PACK[/b]

[left]A cute little summer themed custom content pack to welcome summer! Includes:

[color=#d8d8d8][i][u]COSMETIC BOXES: [/u][/i][/color]These are sold at pierre's. You can click on the boxes to open them. Includes:

1. SUMMER ESSENTIALS BOX: Includes a tanning oil, spf 50 sunscreen and an aloe vera burn relief gel.[/left]
[left]
2:SUMMER GLAMOUR BOX: Includes 5 body mists and 5 body lotions. Body mists give the player colorful mist visuals that follow around the player wherever they go. Body lotions give the player colorful glitter effects that follow the player the same way. They last half a game day. Click on the product to apply it.  Includes:[/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Mermaid Shimmer Body Mist and Lotion
Notes: bergamot, pear, and aquatic notes.[/left]
[left]
Bronze Goddess Body Mist  and Lotion
Notes: coconut, vanilla, and chamomile.[/left]
[left]
Yummy Fruity Body Mist  and Lotion
Notes: mango, passionfruit, and peach.[/left]
[left]
Sweet Hibiscus Body Mist  and Lotion[/left]
[left]Notes: berry, hibiscus, and creme notes.[/left]
[left]
Summer Nights Body Mist  and Lotion[/left]
[left]Notes: gardenia, orange blossom, and woody notes.


[color=#d8d8d8] [i][u]SWIMMABLE POOLS:[/u][/i] [/color]These can be constructed from Robin. Your energy increases in  the pool just like the spa pool. Includes:

1. PINK HEART SHAPED POOL
2. BLUE TILES POOL
3. ROUND FARM POOL


[i][u]4 NEW BUFFS: [/u][/i]Includes:

1. SUNBURN BUFF: If the player stays in the sun more than 4 hours they get sunburned and the sunburn buff becomes active. The player loses a little health and also get's a sunburn effect on their face. To avioid a sunburn, players need to apply sunscreen.

2.SUNBURN RELIEF BUFF: When the player applies sunburn relief aloe vera gel the sunburn goes away and they get this buff.

3.SUN PROTECTION BUFF: When the player applies sunscreen they get this buff and it protects them from a sunburn all day.

4. TANNED BUFF: An hour after applying the tanning oil the player gets a tanned buff and they get a tan effect on their face. The tan lasts 3 days.


[b][i][u]BEACH BAR WITH COCKTAILS[/u][/i]:[/b]
The beach bar can be constructed from robin's shop. Also has colorful lights at night time! You can click on the bar to open a cocktails menu where you can purchase 10 alcoholic cocktails without crafting them. You can check the images to see more.


[b][i][u]FUNCTIONAL SUMMER DECOR:[/u][/i][/b] (see more on images)
Includes:
1. a pink heart glass table, chair and umbrella set.[/left]
[/center]
2. Towels in different colors to sit on the beach
3.Colorful pool floats that can be placed on water

REQUIREMENTS:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6326]Swim
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion sense[/url] (this is for the visual effects from buffs but the rest of the mod will work fine without it too)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher

[color=#efefef]E[/color][/url][color=#efefef]njoy! [/color]
Created by Abrah Mods.
